Turkish special chars: preserved, diacritics normalized, - tokenmonster has üö, çş are decomposed -> upper case versions are not available in the vocab -> they are normalized to small case

Contractions: GPT-2: A select number of english contractions ('s, 'd, 'm, 't, 'll, 've, 're) are manually split into their own tokens. The learning algorithm then decides if they should be their own token or if it should be broken down futher. This makes it impossible to have a token like I'll
Leading Token Is: Start: The tokenizer special handles the start of a sequence so that the token used is unified with the version of that same string that starts as word, e.g. "the quick" uses the same token as "... in the..."
Whitespace Treatment: Byte: The tokenizer just uses bytes for everything so all the whitespaces are represented exactly as they are.

Contractions: GPT-4: Works the same as GPT-2, splits the same contractions
Leading Token Is: Subsequence: A word at the start of a sequence's token is unified with the token when that string is part of a word. e.g. "[the] ... chrysan[the]mum"
Whitespace Treatment: Normalized: Whitespace like " ", "\r", "\n", as well as multiple in a row are normalized to a single space. This stops the tokenizer from being able to understand formatted code.

Contractions: GPT-4o: Works the same as GPT-4, but the contractions are kept as part of the word
Leading Token Is: Special D token: The first token is a special D token, sometimes it is DC when the start is capitalized, and sometimes it is part of the first token.
Whitespace Treatment: Individual: Whitespace is preserved, but each individual whitespace character is represented as it's own token.

Contractions: Learned: Contractions are NOT manually split from the base word. This lets the learning algorithm decide if the contraction should be it's own token or a composition. For example, bloom has 't, n't, and don't as individual tokens, but shan't is split into shan 't
Whitespace Treatment: Manual: Whitespace is preserved, but manual whitespace tokens are created that represent different amounts of whitespace.

Contractions: Composed: The pretokenization splits all contractions into multiple tokens (base, apostrophe, and contraction) which cannot be merged back together in the learning algorithm
Whitespace Treatment: Learned: Whitespace is preserved and the learning algorithm decides how to group them into individual tokens.
